description: A painted battle scene on a steep rocky mountain path. British-style soldiers in white pith helmets and red tunics fire rifles and climb toward a stone fortification with a large wooden gate. Several war elephants are present: one hauls a mounted artillery piece, and others carry riders. Smoke drifts across the slope under a stormy sky. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible border, text, or signature, and there is no gore.
